summary: This tutorial covers how to apply and customize backgrounds in LibreOffice Impress, using a Linux operating system and version 334 of the LibreOffice suite. It explains how to apply a white background to slides and change text color to ensure readability. The tutorial also demonstrates creating a new master slide with a light blue background. Additionally, it shows how to add basic shapes like rectangles and circles to slides, and how to resize them using control points. The guide emphasizes choosing colors that contrast well with the background for better visibility and readability.
